prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A hose repair kit includes a retaining sleeve having a first opening to receive an end of a hose. There is a swivel coupling inserted into a second end of the hose retaining sleeve to engage with the hose. The swivel coupling includes a first annular member with an annular barb at one end and a socket to receive a key at a second end. There is an annular retaining ring groove with a retaining ring therein. A second annular member receives, within an internal bore having an annular recess, the first annular member and the retaining ring engages the annular recess to secure the first annular member to the second annular member. The surface of the bore is frusto-conically shaped allowing the retaining ring to be compressed as it travels into the bore until it reaches the annular recess and expands into and is seated in the annular recess.

A swivel coupling is inserted into a second end of the hose-retaining sleeve to engage the hose. The swivel coupling includes a first annular member having an annular barb at one end and a socket at a second end configured to receive a key. An annular retaining-ring groove is provided with a retaining ring disposed therein. A second annular member receives the first annular member and the retaining ring within an internal bore having an annular recess, such that the retaining ring engages the annular recess to secure the first annular member to the second annular member. outputs.L2: A hose repair assembly has a retention sleeve with an initial opening sized to accept the end of a hose. A swivel connector is fitted into the opposite end of the sleeve so that it can connect with the hose. The swivel connector has a first ring-shaped component that carries an annular barb on one end and, on its other end, a socket configured to accept a key. This component also includes a circumferential groove containing a retaining ring. A second ring-shaped component has an internal passage with a circumferential recess, and it receives the first ring-shaped component. The retaining ring fits into the recess to lock the first component to the second component. The wall of the internal passage is tapered in a frusto-conical form, causing the retaining ring to compress as it moves through the passage, then expand and seat within the circumferential recess once it reaches that recess.
outputs.L3:
The hose repair kit includes a retaining sleeve configured to receive and secure the end of a hose. The retaining sleeve has a first opening sized to accept the hose end, allowing the hose to be positioned within the sleeve for repair or attachment.

A swivel coupling is inserted into the opposite, or second, end of the retaining sleeve. When installed, the swivel coupling engages with the hose to form a secure connection. The swivel coupling is constructed from first and second annular members that are joined together while still permitting the desired coupling function.

The first annular member includes an annular barb at one end. This barb is designed to engage the interior of the hose and help resist withdrawal once the coupling is inserted. At the opposite end of the first annular member is a socket configured to receive a key, tool, or corresponding drive feature that may be used during assembly, tightening, or positioning of the coupling.

A retaining ring is positioned within an annular groove formed on the first annular member. During assembly, this retaining ring cooperates with an annular recess formed in the second annular member. Once the first and second annular members are brought together, the retaining ring expands into the annular recess, thereby securing the two annular members to one another.

The bore of the second annular member includes a frusto-conical surface that assists with installation of the retaining ring. As the first annular member is inserted into the second annular member, the frusto-conical surface gradually compresses the retaining ring inward. This compression allows the retaining ring to pass through the bore until it reaches the annular recess. At that point, the retaining ring expands outward into the recess, locking the first and second annular members together and completing the swivel coupling assembly.
outputs.L4:
A hose repair kit is provided for restoring a damaged hose end and forming a secure replacement connection. The kit includes a retaining sleeve that is fitted over the end portion of the hose and a swivel coupling that is inserted into the hose end. The swivel coupling is designed to provide both a firm mechanical attachment to the hose and a rotatable connection to an external fitting, making the repaired hose practical and convenient to use.

The coupling is formed from two annular coupling members. One of the members includes a barb portion that is inserted into the interior of the hose. The barb grips the inside wall of the hose and helps prevent the coupling from being pulled out during use. The retaining sleeve surrounds the outside of the hose and cooperates with the barb to clamp the hose wall securely between them. This arrangement creates a strong connection without requiring special tools or a complete replacement of the hose.

The coupling also includes a key socket and a retaining ring for joining the two annular members together. During assembly, the retaining ring is positioned so that it passes through a frusto-conical bore in one of the coupling members. As the ring moves through this tapered bore, it is compressed radially inward. Once the ring reaches an annular recess formed in the coupling structure, it expands outward into the recess. This expansion locks the two annular members together while still allowing the swivel function of the coupling.

By using the retaining ring and annular recess arrangement, the coupling members are held together securely and resist separation under normal hose pressure and handling. At the same time, the swivel coupling reduces twisting and kinking of the hose during use. The result is a durable, compact, and easily installed hose repair connection that can restore a damaged hose end and provide reliable service without requiring replacement of the entire hose.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a hose repair kit with a retaining sleeve, swivel coupling, annular barb, retaining ring groove, and frusto-conical bore that compresses the retaining ring until it seats in an annular recess.
counterfactuals.output: A hose repair kit includes a retaining sleeve, a swivel coupling, an annular barb, and a retaining ring configured to secure the kit to an end portion of a hose. The annular barb is insertable into the hose and includes a retaining ring groove for receiving the retaining ring. The retaining sleeve includes a frusto-conical bore dimensioned to progressively compress the retaining ring as the retaining sleeve is advanced over the hose and annular barb. Upon continued advancement, the compressed retaining ring aligns with and expands into an annular recess formed in the retaining sleeve, thereby seating the retaining ring in the annular recess and mechanically locking the retaining sleeve relative to the annular barb. The swivel coupling is rotatably supported relative to the annular barb to permit rotational adjustment of a connected fitting while maintaining a sealed repair connection with the hose.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe, in formal patent language, the structure and operation of a hose repair kit where a swivel coupling is inserted into a hose retaining sleeve and locked by a retaining ring engaging an annular recess.
counterfactuals.output:
A hose repair kit comprises a hose retaining sleeve, a swivel coupling, and a retaining ring configured to secure the swivel coupling to the hose retaining sleeve while permitting relative rotation therebetween.

The hose retaining sleeve includes a generally cylindrical body defining an axial passage configured to receive an end portion of a hose. The hose retaining sleeve may include an internal hose-engaging portion, such as barbs, ribs, teeth, threads, or a compression surface, adapted to grip or retain the hose when the hose end is inserted into the axial passage. The hose retaining sleeve further includes a coupling-receiving end having an opening sized to receive a portion of the swivel coupling.

The swivel coupling includes a coupling body having a first end configured for connection to a mating fluid component and a second end configured to be received within the coupling-receiving end of the hose retaining sleeve. The second end of the swivel coupling includes an exterior cylindrical bearing surface and an annular recess formed circumferentially about the coupling body. The annular recess is spaced from an insertion end of the swivel coupling and is dimensioned to receive at least a portion of the retaining ring.

The retaining ring is positionable in operative engagement with the hose retaining sleeve and the annular recess of the swivel coupling. In one embodiment, the retaining ring is received in a corresponding groove or ring seat associated with the hose retaining sleeve and extends radially inwardly into the annular recess of the swivel coupling. The retaining ring thereby axially locks the swivel coupling relative to the hose retaining sleeve by preventing withdrawal of the swivel coupling from the coupling-receiving end. The retaining ring and annular recess are configured to permit circumferential movement of the swivel coupling relative to the hose retaining sleeve, such that the swivel coupling remains rotatable after assembly.

In operation, a damaged portion of a hose is removed or an end of the hose is prepared for repair. The hose end is inserted into the axial passage of the hose retaining sleeve and secured by the hose-engaging portion. The second end of the swivel coupling is then inserted into the coupling-receiving end of the hose retaining sleeve until the annular recess of the swivel coupling is aligned with the retaining ring. The retaining ring is installed, or resiliently snaps into place, so as to occupy both the ring seat of the hose retaining sleeve and the annular recess of the swivel coupling. Engagement of the retaining ring with opposed annular shoulders of the recess resists axial separation of the swivel coupling from the hose retaining sleeve. At the same time, clearance between the retaining ring and the annular recess allows the swivel coupling to rotate about the longitudinal axis of the hose retaining sleeve.

Accordingly, the hose repair kit provides a repair connection in which the hose is retained within the sleeve and the swivel coupling is mechanically captured by the retaining ring. The annular recess and retaining ring cooperate to form an axial retention mechanism while preserving swivel movement, thereby facilitating connection of the repaired hose to another fitting without twisting the hose.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise technical summary of an invention involving a hose repair kit, including a first annular member with a barb and key socket, a second annular member with a tapered bore, and a retaining ring connection.
counterfactuals.output: The invention is a hose repair kit for rejoining or repairing a damaged hose using interlocking annular components. The kit includes a first annular member configured to be inserted into or coupled with a hose end, the first annular member having an external barb for gripping the hose and a key socket for receiving a tool or mating feature to aid installation or locking. A second annular member includes a tapered bore sized to receive and compress the hose or the first annular member, thereby improving sealing and mechanical retention. The first and second annular members are secured together by a retaining ring connection, which prevents axial separation after assembly. The resulting coupling provides a compact, mechanically secure, and leak-resistant hose repair joint without requiring replacement of the entire hose.

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the components of a hose repair kit in patent abstract form, emphasizing how a frusto-conical internal bore compresses a retaining ring during insertion and allows it to expand into a recess.
counterfactuals.output: A hose repair kit includes a coupling body for joining or repairing a hose end, the coupling body having an internal frusto-conical bore leading to an annular recess. A retaining ring is positioned on or with an insertable hose-engaging member and is radially compressed as the member is driven through the progressively narrowing frusto-conical bore. Upon reaching the recess, the retaining ring resiliently expands outwardly into the recess to lock the member against withdrawal. The kit may further include one or more sealing elements, such as O-rings or gaskets, and hose-clamping or gripping portions arranged to provide a fluid-tight connection between the hose and the coupling body. The frusto-conical bore thereby functions as a camming surface that temporarily contracts the retaining ring during assembly and permits automatic expansion of the ring into the recess to secure the repaired hose connection.
